latestVersion.changelog:
ad-creative 0.1.0

- Initial release of the ad-creative skill for generating, iterating, and scaling ad copy for any paid ads platform.
- Supports both "generate from scratch" and "iterate from performance data" workflows.
- Includes detailed platform specs (character limits, formatting rules) for Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Twitter/X.
- Step-by-step process for asking the right context questions, defining ad angles, and validating copy against specs.
- Guidance for integrating visual and video ad creative with generative AI tools and code-based video rendering.
- Structured workflow to help users produce high-performing ad headlines, descriptions, and variations at scale.
